Accommodation options
Whether you’re a first-year school leaver, a current undergraduate or postgraduate student, we have a place for you to call home while you study.
Explore our range of Halls and Residences
From first-year school leaver halls to undergraduate and postgraduate residences, find the right place for you.
Explore our properties
Compare your options
Not sure where to start? Take a look at our quick comparison of first-year school leavers halls and undergraduate and postgraduate residences.
Explore our properties
Are you a first-year school leaver?
Find accommodation options, application information and support for school leavers starting their first year at the university.
Find out more
Are you an undergraduate or postgraduate student?
Explore accommodation options for undergraduate and postgraduate students, including residence choices, independent living and how to apply.
Find out more
International students
Explore accommodation options for international students, including eligibility, application dates, residence options and how to apply.
Find out more
Couples and families
Accommodation for couples and families, with information on available residences, apartment options, eligibility and family accommodation requirements.
Find out more
Group applications
We offer group accommodation where you and your mates can apply to live together.
Find out more
Accessible accommodation
Find accessible accommodation and support for students with disabilities, health needs or specific living requirements.
Find out more
Community living
Discover culturally supportive accommodation communities for Māori and Pacific students, with opportunities for connection, academic support and leadership.
Find out more
Summer Accommodation
Find summer accommodation options for eligible students, interns and visiting researchers, including available residences, dates, rates and booking information.
Find out more
